maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new Zimmatic pivot irrigation equipment sold via dealers, plus road safety products like crash cushions for new projects.

publicly_funded.reason: Larger irrigation segment sells to private farmers via dealers; infrastructure road-safety sales to government are the smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own irrigation and infrastructure products; acquisitions only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Farmers could buy other pivot brands, though FieldNET and dealer ties add some friction; mostly equipment purchases.

notes: Irrigation is the larger segment; infrastructure (road safety) is the smaller one. Lindsay's irrigation sales are partly replacement and parts.
